expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's people strategy and lead the HR function - advise the board on culture, workforce, and employment risk - represent the organisation on people matters with partners and regulators

You can: - set the organisation's workforce strategy and long-term plan - make workforce trade-offs across services with finance and service leaders - shape workforce plans with partners across the health and care system

You can: - set the organisational development strategy and culture programme - coach executives and lead large-scale cultural change - link culture and engagement measures to quality of care and performance

You can: - set the organisation's people policy framework and approach to legal risk - anticipate changes in employment law and plan the organisation's response - advise the board on employment risk and liability

You can: - change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs - lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level - understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills - coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - manage large or multiple budgets and set financial plans - make funding trade-offs across services
You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance

You can: - shape organisational strategy using a deep understanding of the health and care system - represent the organisation with health and care partners and leaders - anticipate how policy and service changes will affect digital services and care
